records.quote: All diseases were conquered. So was old age.
records.paraphrase: Explanation that disease and aging have been eliminated.

records.quote: The painter sat on the top of his stepladder, looking down reflectively on the sorry scene.
records.paraphrase: Painter's reaction after witnessing the killings.

records.quote: Without population control, human beings would now be packed on this surface of this old planet like drupelets on a blackberry! Think of it!
records.paraphrase: Extrapolation of the consequences of no population control.

records.quote: There were no prisons, no slums, no insane asylums, no cripples, no poverty, no wars.
records.paraphrase: Description of the absence of various social problems in the world.

records.quote: Wehling, the waiting father, mumbled something without raising his head. And then he fell silent again.
records.paraphrase: Reaction of Wehling to the situation in the waiting room.

records.quote: A sardonic old man, about two hundred years old, sat on a stepladder, painting a mural he did not like.
records.paraphrase: Indication of a cure for aging allowing people to live 200 years.
Idealistic opening statement contrasting later violence.
